Chicken Kottu.note: Godamba roti = wheat (stated egg-free) plus egg in the stir-fry. Curry gravy names no dairy. Spicy.

Egg Kottu.note: Wheat roti, two eggs, vegetable gravy. Spicy.

Cheese Kottu.note: Wheat roti, egg, chicken curry; cheddar and cheese sauce = milk. Mildly spicy.

Vegetable Kottu.note: Egg-free wheat roti, vegetables, vegetable gravy, no egg; merchant tags vegan. Spicy.

Beef Kottu.note: Wheat roti, egg, beef curry. Very spicy.

Kottu Meal.note: Union of its default parts: Chicken Kottu (wheat, egg), two Parippu Vadai (none), Ceylon Milk Tea (condensed milk). The milk tea is the stated default, the ginger beer a swap (v12 ruling 2). Spicy from the kottu.

Plain Hoppers.note: Rice flour and coconut milk (not milk), yeast-fermented with no toddy, so no alcohol. Not spicy.

Egg Hoppers.note: Egg; lunu miris on the side is a default part with Maldive fish = fish, so not vegetarian. Chilli relish on the side = 1.

Hopper Feast.note: Egg hopper; pol sambol and seeni sambol with Maldive fish. The three curries are picks the line does not name, so none is counted (v12 ruling 2). Stated mildly spicy.

String Hoppers Set.note: Rice-flour string hoppers (no gluten); pol sambol with Maldive fish. The two curries are unnamed picks, not counted. Mildly spicy. Mutton curry is the add-on that is out.

Lamprais.note: Ghee = milk; frikkadel breadcrumbs = gluten, egg; boiled egg; moju mustard seeds; seeni sambol Maldive fish; prawn blachan = crustaceans. Chicken stock. Spicy.

Devilled Chicken.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten; cornflour has no gluten; ketchup adds nothing. Very spicy.

Fish Ambul Thiyal.note: Tuna = fish. Goraka and pepper. Spicy.

Chicken Curry.note: Coconut milk is not milk; curry leaves. Spicy.

Dhal Curry.note: Lentils (not a listed allergen), coconut milk; mustard-seed tempering = mustard. Stated not spicy, no chilli named.

Kiribath with Lunu Miris.note: Rice and coconut milk; the lunu miris served with it has Maldive fish, so not vegetarian. Chilli relish on the side = 1.

Pol Sambol.note: Coconut is not a tree nut; Maldive fish = fish. Spicy.

Parippu Vadai.note: Split lentils, green chilli, onion. Mildly spicy.

Isso Vadai.note: Whole prawn. Lentil batter has no gluten. Sold out.

Fish Cutlets.note: Mackerel; egg and breadcrumb coating. Mildly spicy.

Wattalapam.note: Eggs; cashew nuts. Coconut milk is not milk; jaggery.

Faluda.note: Milk and ice cream (stated egg-free); agar jelly, so vegetarian and halal; basil seeds are not sesame.
